HelpText:
Click the "Start" button for your wanted Hunt Log.
BumpOnALog will complete all current mob entries for your rank.

If your character has enough GrandCompany seals and the appropriate level,
'Bump On A Log' will progress through your Grand Company ranks up until 2nd Lieutenant.

Change your settings if you want it to stop earlier.
CycleTooltipFmt: Run this log on {0} enabled characters using their selected gearsets.
StartTooltip: Run this log on the current character.
CycleNeedsTitleScreen: Log in or return to the title screen before starting the cycle.
InvalidCycleGearsetFmt: {0}@{1}: gearset {2} must be a combat class or job that supports this hunting log.
NoneGearsetTooltip: Keep this character's currently equipped gearset.
AutoRetainerUnavailable: Enable AutoRetainer to load the character list.
LoginForLog: Log in to view this hunting log.
NoHuntLogForClass: There is no hunt log for your class!
NotInGrandCompany: You are not in any Grand Company!
FinishedAllGCRanks: You finished all hunt log ranks for your grand company!
GCRankNotUnlocked: The required Grand Company rank has not yet been unlocked!
FinishedAllRanks: You finished all hunt log ranks!
